items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XI, List of Answers on Topics 113:1
items.html: For there is the phase of the screen and the coarseness with which the upper light couples and raises reflected light. As above in Answer 183; see there. And therefore it is that which enlarges and measures the measure of the Mochin. (There)
